statement: Every asset listed here is derived from a file produced by a real run of this project. No asset is an artist's impression and none was sourced from a third party.

assets.note: Genuine Webots R2025a render from the drone's scene Camera node. Labels are placed by projecting the configured world coordinates through the recorded camera pose; no scene element was redrawn.
Scaled plan drawn directly from the scenario JSON that generates the Webots world, so the map cannot drift from the simulated geometry.

Top: supervisor-reported cart position against the closed-form path it is driven from (exact by construction; labelled as such on the figure). Bottom: the genuinely independent comparison of the measured LiDAR scan against an analytic ray-cast during the same episode.
Sector ranges read from the Webots Lidar device compared against an analytic ray-cast of the same scene from the same pose.
Point estimates and Wilson 95% intervals computed by tests/client_experiments.py over 90 recorded episodes.
Flown paths as recorded by the simulator for the first episode of each mode/controller cell, including the episodes that failed.

assets.kind: frame extracted from the demonstration video
assets.note: Single frame at t = 22.0 s of the recorded Webots run; not re-rendered.
